oneOf.description: Who can create spaces.
Extra install-level gate on top of bit 41.
Extra install-level gate on top of bit 42.
Who can archive channels.
`@channel`/`@here` in bigger channels needs MANAGE_CHANNELS.
Who can invite guests.
Whether guests may DM people they share no channel with.
Edit window in seconds; 0 = forever.
Whether members may delete their own messages.
GIF search on/off.
GIF provider name.
Reference to the GIF provider's API key.
Link previews on/off.
Largest upload in bytes.
Per-space file quota in bytes; 0 = none.
Custom emoji per space.
Company retention default in days; 0 = forever.
Whether space admins may join private channels by themselves.
Whether guests see presence.
Email digest on/off.
Whether members may DM agent members.
Strip GPS and other location metadata from image originals at upload.

Days deleted and edited-away content is kept before purge; 0 = off.
A read-only mirror of the install retention row.
Guest access on/off; off suspends every guest reversibly.
The install's default notification level for people.
What an email digest names: `names` or `counts`.

Whether the call security code is shown: `shown` or `hidden`; `required` is
reserved and refused.
Whether members may start calls in DMs and group DMs.
Whether members may record calls.

Whether persons may record DM and group-DM calls (feeds
`PermPolicies.recording_dm_enabled`).
The default audio keep days of a recording.
The most audio keep days a recording may ask for.
Declining the recording notice means not joining.
Meetings on/off.
Who may host meetings.
Most people in one meeting.
Longest planned meeting, `ends_at` − `starts_at`, in minutes.
How long an empty room waits after `ends_at` before the meeting ends.
Free text naming who to ask about meeting privacy, shown to guests.

Meeting links let outside guests in: off refuses `peek` and
`redeem` and revokes every link-guest session.

The call-stats beacon on/off: on, voice joins carry
`stats` and `POST /api/v1/me/voice/stats` takes aggregate samples; off (the
default), the route answers `403 policy_denied`.

A short message `preview` on the mgmt person notification feed: off (the
default), the feed carries ids only.

The profile fields K2 owns in K2 mode (a list of [`ManagedProfileField`]).
Unset: the default (`display_name`, `title`, `pronouns`; members upload their own
avatar). Set over mgmt only; a standalone install ignores it.
